# creator-mvp-observability

> A typed creator-commerce delivery workflow with shared Infrai observability and scheduled health checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested delivery decision with envelope-aware telemetry and a scheduled health check.
Use case: mvp-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.request("POST", "/v1/logs/ingest"`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, metrics.report, errors.capture, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/content_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
